adults with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent
approvals.approval_summary: On August 13, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration granted accelerated approval to iberdomide (Zenbexus, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company) in combination with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone for adults with multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent.

On August 25, 2026, the Food and Drug Administration approved zanidatamab-hrii (Ziihera, Jazz Pharmaceuticals): in combination with fluoropyrimidine- and platinum-containing chemotherapy and tislelizumab-jsgr (Tevimbra, BeOne Medicines USA, Inc.), as first-line treatment for adults with HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+) unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and in combination with fluoropyrimidine-, and platinum-containing chemotherapy, as first-line treatment for adults with HER2-positive (IHC 3+) unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, or esophageal adenocarcinoma, as detected by an FDA-approved test.
